author: (Esper) J.V.Lamouroux, 1809

note.en: A sea-grape type Caulerpa with one unverified iNaturalist record here; it is hard to separate from Caulerpa racemosa without a microscope.
note.es: Una Caulerpa de tipo uva de mar con un solo registro sin verificar en iNaturalist; es difícil separarla de Caulerpa racemosa sin microscopio.

evidence: iNaturalist: 1 unverified record in the region
